scope: Non-pristine functional-method reproduction only; no Experiment 1, O-influence tracing, or G-suitability adjudication.

pytorch3d due to flow_euler -> point_mesh_dist and default optimization_step=1
rembg and onnxruntime because trellis.pipelines imports the image pipeline package

coloredlogs, humanfriendly, flatbuffers, protobuf from onnxruntime
unused_or_unreached: flash_attn because the source fixes ATTN_BACKEND=xformers
nvdiffrast, diffoctreerast, and MIP-splatting diff-gaussian-rasterization; no import/load path reached any of them before the source/configuration blocker
unresolved_historical_provenance: Sixteen author file:// Conda/build workspace records remain without immutable artifact identities.
nvdiffrast, diffoctreerast, and MIP-splatting diff-gaussian-rasterization remain author-unpinned. No functional substitute was selected because they were not reached.

minimal_run.configuration: Entry-point defaults retained: seed=1, sparse denoise steps=100, slat steps=25, cfg_strength=1.0, cfg_interval=[0.5,1.0], rescale_t=3.0, alpha_eta=0.1, optimization_step=1, lr_sample=1e-5, mesh_points=16384.
minimal_run.result: No sparse structure, mesh, or points were materialized. Only source preprocessing artifacts input_sample.ply and prompt.txt were created.

first_semantic_blocker.evidence: The fixed pipeline.json model map contains sparse_structure_decoder, sparse_structure_flow_model, slat_decoder_gs, slat_decoder_rf, slat_decoder_mesh, and slat_flow_model, but no sparse_structure_encoder. Pipeline.from_pretrained constructs self.models exclusively from that map.
first_semantic_blocker.consequence: The official run_lascomp path deterministically accesses an absent model key after checkpoint loading. Adding an encoder/checkpoint or changing that source path would change the released method/configuration.
first_semantic_blocker.load_probe: Official checkpoints loaded and pipeline.cuda() completed successfully before this blocked inference path.
